global: War with {enemy_faction} again. Fine. Stock your bread and sharpen your spears before anyone rides out.
Another declaration from {enemy_faction}. I sat through three of these, and the roads still came back in one piece.
New folks, stay near the walls for a few days. Wars look thrilling from a distance and feel very different up close.
{my_faction} will hold the eastern ford. Come find us if you want a fight, or come find us after for the tea.
Back in the first war, {enemy_faction} lost a siege over one missing supply cart. Count your carts before your kills.
Declarations are cheap. Walls, grain and patience win these things, and {my_faction} has all three. Keep it that way.
I'm too old to chase {enemy_faction} across the moors twice a week. Bring your best, and I'll bring the bandages.
Nobody needs to panic over this. Gather your people, read the map, and remember who you're fighting beside.
